title: Personal variables declaration
description: Declare variables to store your name, age, and height (in meters), and print the values to the console.
hints: Remember: String for text, int for integers, double for decimals
solutionExplanation: We declare three variables with different types: String for the name, int for the age, and double for the height. Then we print each value concatenated with descriptive text.

title: Area calculator with constants
description: Declare constants for the length and width of a rectangle, calculate its area and perimeter, and print the formatted results.
hints: Use final for the constants and name them in UPPERCASE
solutionExplanation: We declare LARGO and ANCHO as constants with final. We calculate the area by multiplying length by width, and the perimeter with the formula 2*(length+width). We use printf to format the decimals.

title: Temperature conversion with casting
description: Create a temperature converter that takes Celsius as a constant, converts it to Fahrenheit and Kelvin, and correctly handles the numeric types.
solutionExplanation: We use 9.0/5.0 (not 9/5) because 9/5 in integers gives 1, not 1.8. Division with decimals preserves precision. The (int) fahrenheit cast truncates the decimal part without rounding.
